baseline.ingress: pack one recorded receiver to contiguous CI16 inside the timed call
baseline.detector: NativeDwell maximum=1 seeded=false from the same candidate library

candidate.ingress: natural stride-4 recorded receiver view with no Python packing
candidate.detector: NativeStridedBlindV4 maximum=1 seeded=true, 512-bin whole-dwell rank proposal passed directly to confirmation

decision.positive: fractional_complete is true and exact_score - control_score is strictly greater than 0.025
decision.retention: tracking.reference_match against the independently timed packed unseeded baseline observation
decision.extras: every candidate-positive receiver-visit not associated by reference_match

timing.order: counterbalanced by case ordinal plus receiver plus repetition
timing.scope: thread CPU and monotonic wall around receiver selection/packing plus the complete detector call; file loading and hashes excluded

controls.use: run only after all development rows; report independently; never tune
